meta.title: syafiqkit skills
meta.description: 59 workflow skills from the syafiqkit Claude Code plugin: commits, shipping, task docs, AGENTS.md upkeep, UI/UX design judgement, animation, PDFs, user manuals and more. Ask for a skill by name or let the agent pick one. Each skill is translated to Harness tools when loaded. Claude Code-only parts (menu bar, /sk, haiku agents) are not included. Optional: set outputStyle: true in the plugin config to add syafiqkit's ADHD-oriented answer style to every session.
